items.headline: Primark Commits to Scaling Recycled Cotton in Denim Initiative
items.blurb: Designers sourcing denim can expect expanded access to post-consumer recycled fibers as major retailers collaborate to solve production challenges.

items.headline: Arvind Limited Launches Advanced Production Hub in Uttar Pradesh
items.blurb: Expands manufacturing capacity with cutting-edge technology, offering design teams faster turnarounds and enhanced production capabilities.

items.headline: Chloris Advances Bio-Dye Certification for Textile Mills

items.blurb: Engineered bacteria could replace toxic chemical dyeing, reducing fashion's environmental footprint while opening new design possibilities.

items.headline: Vintage Denim Becomes Go-To Base for Classic Horror Costume Design
